name: GenusPlus Group Ltd
summary: GenusPlus Group Ltd engages in the construction and maintenance of transmission and distribution power lines and substations in Australia. It operates through Infrastructure, Services, and Energy and Engineering segments. The company builds, upgrades, and maintains distribution networks; and network augmentation, as well as provision of high-voltage substations, transmission infrastructure, and grid connection process support services. It also delivers electrical and infrastructure solutions for wind farms; renewable grid integration; balance-of-plant infrastructure; and substations that connect solar, wind, and storage projects, as well as constructs and commissions BESS projects.
